This games looks interesting. Is it online only? Does it have a single player mode? What's the plot? Will it work on Windows 7/8?

Terraria is not online only, it's a single player game with a multiplayer option.

It's a sandbox, you can reshape the whole world as you like, it's a sort of mix between a minecraft 2D and a platformer. It doesn't have an actual story (it's not a roleplaying game or a graphic adventure) but it does have a progression, both for you characters and different events that happen while you progress through the game.

Crafting is massive, tons of recipes and materials, and everything you do is useful.

I have it on WIndows 7 and it works perfectly, I don't know about 8. They also recently released a native Linux client.

It's a fun game, well worth its cost imo, the PC version is the most complete, mobile versions lack some features like fishing.

Edit: for multiplayer you can either join an existing server or setup your own (on the PC version, the server is included when you buy the game).
